name: instagram-follower-checker
description: A modern, sleek, and minimal client-side website to check who doesn't follow you back on Instagram.

scripts.build: mkdir -p public && cp index.html script.js style.css public/ && cp -r mock-data public/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r images public/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
